sources.snippet: Llama 3.3 is a text-only 70B instruction-tuned model that provides enhanced performance relative to Llama 3.1 70B-and relative to Llama 3.2 90B when used for text-only applications. Moreover, for some applications, Llama 3.3 70B approaches the performance of Llama 3.1 405B.
